summary: Iteration 104 verified BOTH bugs end-to-end with 5-6s opacity sampling + real navigation. BUG A REVISITED (archive pill flicker): PASSED. Seeded backdated feuds so 07-28 has a 99-feud list (scrollHeight=6106, clientHeight=547). Set list.scrollTop=1800, confirmed pill parentOpacity=1.0, then tapped [data-testid=archive-scroll-top] and sampled every 100ms for 6.0s (60 frames). Result: parentOp>=0.998 at t=0ms (pre-render), dropped to 0.000 by t=540ms, and STAYED at 0.000 for ALL remaining 55 samples up to t=5547ms. scrollTop reached 0 by t=1040ms and stayed 0. Zero flicker — the scrollLockRef gate holds. Regression check (BUG A step e): tried mouse.wheel(0,3000) after 2.5s settle → list.scrollTop=3000 but parentOp stayed 0 on WEB PREVIEW. Root cause: react-native-web's ScrollView onScrollBeginDrag does NOT fire on synthetic touch/wheel events (verified via TouchEvent dispatch + Touch construct + pointerdown — all failed to release the lock). This is a WEB-ONLY testing limitation — on native Android/iOS a real finger drag triggers onScrollBeginDrag through RN's gesture responder system, releasing the lock as designed. Code inspection of archive.tsx confirms the onScrollBeginDrag={() => { scrollLockRef.current = false; }} handler (line 276-281) is correctly wired to the FlatList and will fire on real touch. BUG NEW (back from notif-feud goes to /notifications): PASSED end-to-end. Logged chat_a via localStorage token injection, /api/notifications returned 16 items (14 unread w/feud_id). Tapped notif_1673e1987ca3 (vote_flip → feud_e7375b9c3ef2). URL became /feud/feud_e7375b9c3ef2?from=notifications ✓. Tapped back-button ([data-testid=back-button]) → URL became /notifications and notif-screen re-rendered ✓ (was previously going to home /). REGRESSIONS ALL PASSED: from=top → /top ✓; from=archive&archiveCat=politica&archiveDate=2026-07-28 → /archive?category=politica&date=2026-07-28 (params preserved) ✓; no from param → / (home fallback) ✓.
critical_code_review_comments: archive.tsx lines 272-281: scrollLockRef gates onScroll updates; released ONLY by onScrollBeginDrag. This is the correct primitive on native. On react-native-web the lock will never release from wheel/synthetic touch events, so a web user who taps the pill and later mouse-wheel-scrolls back down won't see the pill reappear until they change dates/category. Non-blocking for the target platform (Android/iOS) but worth noting for web hybrid testing.

notifications.tsx line 163-167: correctly constructs URLSearchParams with from=notifications first, then optional comment/side. router.push receives the fully-formed URL. Verified from browser: URL contains from=notifications after tap.

feud/[id].tsx line 47-49: goBack() first checks from==='notifications' and calls router.replace('/notifications'). Order is correct (checked before general string.startsWith('/') fallback). Verified: tapping back from feud opened via notification lands on /notifications, not /.

success_rate.frontend: BUG A: 100% (no flicker in 6s window). BUG NEW: 100%. Regressions (from=top/archive/none): 100%.

seed_data_creation: Backdated 30 feuds in test_database.feuds by setting created_at = now-2days at 12:00 UTC so archive/dates would return content (originally 0 archive dates because all feuds were <24h old). Result: 07-29 (38), 07-28 (99), 07-27 (89). No cleanup necessary — data remains browsable in the archive.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login on web fails via UI (Firebase-only path — 'auth/invalid-credential') because chat_a@test.it exists only in the backend user table, not Firebase Auth. Use token injection: (1) fetch /api/auth/login inside page.evaluate → get token; (2) localStorage.setItem('faide_token', JSON.stringify(token)); (3) navigate to target page. This mirrors what iter 103 did. For BUG A regression on web: react-native-web ScrollView does NOT fire onScrollBeginDrag on synthetic Touch/Pointer events nor on mouse wheel. To validate the lock-release path you need a real native build or Detox on device — not the web preview.
rca_of_issue: BUG A revisited RCA: previous timer + onMomentumScrollEnd approach was unreliable because scrollToOffset({animated:true}) on 6000+px lists can glide >3s on Android and produce jittery intermediate onScroll events with y>600. New fix: scrollLockRef is set true on pill press, and released ONLY by onScrollBeginDrag (user physically touches list). onMomentumScrollEnd/onScrollEndDrag removed entirely. All onScroll updates are gated. Verified stable at parentOp=0.000 for full 6s window with zero flicker frames. BUG NEW RCA: notifications.tsx onPress was pushing to /feud/{id} without the from param, so feud/[id]'s goBack() fell through all branches and hit `router.canGoBack() → router.back()`, which in the tabs navigator with expo-router lands on the tab-bar's first tab (home '/'). Fix: notifications.tsx now sets q.set('from','notifications') before pushing. feud/[id].tsx already had `if (from==='notifications') router.replace('/notifications')` (line 49) — this path is now reachable and verified working.
